record.what_it_does: SendGrid (a Twilio product) is a cloud email API and SMTP service for sending transactional and marketing emails at scale, with tools for templates, contacts, deliverability, and analytics.
record.auth_notes: SendGrid API keys are sent as a static Bearer token in the Authorization header (`Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`); keys can be scoped with restricted permissions. There is no OAuth2 flow for calling the API — an 'OAuth 2.0' option that appears in the docs applies only to securing inbound Event Webhook deliveries, not to API calls made to SendGrid.
record.access_notes: Sign-up is instant and free, and an API key can be generated immediately, but since March 25, 2025 all new accounts (Email API and Marketing Campaigns) get only a 60-day timed trial capped at 100 emails/day; after the trial, sending stops until you upgrade to a paid plan (Essentials from ~$19.95/mo). Some legacy accounts created before that date, or via certain partners, may retain an ongoing free plan.
record.main_blocker: new accounts get only a 60-day/100-email-per-day trial before a paid plan is required, and sender identity/domain verification is required before mail send works
